findings.issue: apiFetch permanently caches failed fetches (res.ok false or network rejection), so a transient API error turns any resource into a permanent null — rendered as 'Not found' or blank data until the process restarts.
findings.suggestion: Only cache successful results: on non-2xx or rejection, delete the cached promise so the next call retries; optionally cap the cache with an LRU.

findings.issue: The 250ms debounce timer is never cleared when the component unmounts; typing in Search then immediately clicking a card causes a delayed navigate() back to the filtered home URL.
The search input's value is bound to the server-fetched d().q, so a refetch resolving mid-typing reverts the field's contents.
findings.suggestion: Keep the input value in a local createSignal, initialised from the URL, and only re-sync from the URL on navigation (not from query results).

findings.issue: EvoNode dereferences props.node.evolutions without a guard; a failed evolution-chain fetch (evolution: null) throws in the template.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the tree in <Show when={d().evolution}> or default evolutions to [].

findings.issue: Out-of-range ?page is silently clamped to totalPages while the URL keeps the old value, so the URL and the rendered 'Page n of m' disagree.
findings.suggestion: Either clamp visibly by navigating to the clamped page, or leave the page indicator consistent with the URL.

findings.issue: Hidden module-level Map cache with no bound or invalidation; fine for this fixed snapshot but a leak-shaped pattern if reused elsewhere.
findings.suggestion: Document the cache's scope and lifetime, or move it behind a small named cache helper with a size cap.

findings.issue: The EM_DASH num() helper is duplicated between the move route and MoveTables.
findings.suggestion: Move num()/EM_DASH formatting into lib/util.js next to EM_DASH.

findings.issue: updateParams and pageHref both hand-build URLSearchParams from location.search; duplicated query-plumbing that a future filter would have to change in two places.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single buildHref(patch) helper used by both the handlers and the pagination links.

findings.issue: The root Suspense has no fallback, so during data streaming the main landmark is empty (header/footer pop in first).
findings.suggestion: Add a minimal loading fallback inside main for first paint; not a correctness issue.

summary: A genuinely idiomatic SolidStart v2 app — server queries, preloads, file routing and build config all match the current docs, with the one hand-rolled hash-scroll workaround being justified by a real router gap. The main merge blockers are correctness nits the acceptance tests can't see: permanently cached fetch failures, an uncleaned debounce timer that can hijack navigation, and an input that can revert under fast typing. I'd merge after one small round of fixes.
